The regional movement combines a geopolitical energy shock with concern that expensive borrowing could slow data-centre construction and other AI investment. The two drivers are related in market pricing but should not be treated as proof of a single cause for every index move.
Reuters reporting separately described Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan down 0.2% and Korean shares down more than 1% early Thursday, which is directionally consistent but taken at a different time.
